title: Security & Defensive Coding
description: Security challenges: input validation, encryption, vulnerability prevention, secure coding patterns

problems.title: SQL Injection Prevention
problems.description: Refactor vulnerable code to prevent SQL injection attacks. Implement parameterized queries and input validation.
requirements: Replace string concatenation with parameterized queries
Validate and sanitize all user inputs
Implement allowlist for dynamic column names

problems.title: Password Hashing and Verification
problems.description: Implement secure password storage using modern hashing algorithms with salting and key stretching.
requirements: Use Argon2id or bcrypt for hashing

test_cases.expected: Returns hash with embedded salt, different each call

evaluation_criteria.algorithm: Uses recommended algorithm with proper parameters

problems.title: XSS Prevention Filter
problems.description: Implement an XSS filter that sanitizes HTML content while preserving safe formatting tags.
requirements: Allowlist of safe tags (p, b, i, a, ul, li)

problems.title: Secrets Manager
problems.description: Build a secrets manager that encrypts secrets at rest, supports key rotation, and provides secure access control.
requirements: Key rotation without re-encrypting all secrets

test_cases.expected: New secrets use new key, old secrets still readable

evaluation_criteria.memory: Secrets cleared from memory after use

problems.title: CSRF Protection Middleware
problems.description: Implement CSRF protection using double-submit cookie pattern with token validation.

test_cases.input: POST /transfer with valid token in header and cookie

evaluation_criteria.usability: Works with AJAX and form submissions
